Nell Miller (born 25 February 2000) is an inactive English tennis player. Miller currently plays college tennis at North Carolina State . [ 1 ] In 2022, Miller and doubles partner Jaeda Daniel became the first NC State players to win the NCAA Division I Women's Doubles Championship. [ 2 ] Miller and Daniel additionally earned ITA All-American accolade in 2022. [ 3 ] [ 4 ] In June 2022, Miller and partner Sonay Kartal earned a wildcard entry into the women's doubles draw in Wimbledon .
